system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: At 13:39:51 UTC, the proxy recorded a successful GET for a PowerShell script at raw.githubusercontent.com/harbor-dental-it/tools/main/u.ps1. This is shortly before the reported PowerShell window, but the record does not establish that the script was executed or what it contained.

At 13:37 UTC, WS-MLOPEZ-01 accessed Google Drive, including its My Drive page and Drive data endpoint. Google Drive is not among the listed approved services, but these requests alone do not establish a file upload or data exfiltration.

At 13:40:53 UTC, WS-MLOPEZ-01 established an SMB connection to DC-HD-01, and the DC logged a network logon for the workstation computer account. The records do not identify a human user or show which share or files were accessed.

The script retrieval shortly before the reported PowerShell window, combined with access to an unapproved cloud-storage service, warrants investigation; the available records do not establish malicious execution or activity.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied sensor coverage status reports a winsec and Sysmon collection outage on WS-MLOPEZ-01 from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC, overlapping the reported PowerShell window. Process creation and other endpoint events in that interval therefore cannot be assessed from those sensors.
The available proxy and connection records show network activity but do not provide the retrieved script contents or establish that it ran.
claims_not_established: Whether PowerShell ran on WS-MLOPEZ-01 during the reported interval, and, if so, which command or script ran.
Whether the retrieved script was malicious, authorized, or executed.
Whether any files were uploaded to Google Drive or other data was exfiltrated.
Which SMB share or files, if any, were accessed on DC-HD-01, and whether that activity was authorized.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover endpoint process, PowerShell operational/script-block, and EDR telemetry for WS-MLOPEZ-01 covering 13:30–14:10 UTC.
Retrieve and assess the exact u.ps1 content and its repository provenance, including whether it matches approved IT tooling.
